proposal:
STATUS: nothing executed; hand derivations from the supplied code; slips possible. No polynomial-SAT claim.

A. AUDIT.
1. _verify_certificate builds blocks from every original clause, requires one count per block, compares each quotient slice with the original on all 2^|S| local points using only forms supported inside S, and checks P·L=I entrywise. Local equality plus linear surjectivity gives equisatisfiability. Budgets are tested before each block loop; every skip returns the original input. I find no unsound path, and the alleged omitted-block bug is absent.
2. probe returns UNSAT only after the subset check, a verified compression of the core and 2-SAT failure. That is sound at both stages.
3. Residual work is at most (1+2·Σ_layers|S|)·(C_IALH+C_DP) plus pruning. With fixed caps C_IALH is constant but large: up to 8192 UP runs of O(n·L) each, plus HNF. Four avoidable or unbounded costs:
(i) lru_cache keys the raw restricted state, not the canon_plus output, consistent with the trusted 4-of-12 repeat.
(ii) refute runs before elim_plus, so IALH is paid even when DP alone decides.
(iii) attempt materialises all pos×neg resolvents and quadratic subsumption before its size test.
(iv) dual_certificate's rank-deficient HNF branch has no modulus, hence no bit bound.
These are consistent with slow peak-1 pigeonhole runs without any exponential claim.

B. MECHANISM: REVERSE-DP (RDP).
Rule. If F contains B={l∨R : l∈L, R∈Γ} (non-tautological) and x is fresh, replace B by {¬x∨l : l∈L} ∪ {x∨R : R∈Γ}.
Exactness lemma (Lean target). For every assignment α of the old variables, α satisfies F iff some value of x extends α to a model of F'. (⇐) Resolve on x. (⇒) If α satisfies every l, take x=1; otherwise some l is false, so every R is true, and x=0 works.
This is bounded variable addition (Manthey–Heule–Biere, cited from memory); I claim no novelty for the rule. What matters here: it is the exact inverse of the deployed DP step. It needs no symmetry, no GF(2) kernel, no truth table and no width cap. It consumes only clauses explicitly present, so arbitrary extra clauses cannot make it unsound. The certificate check is |L|·|Γ| clause look-ups.
Pair detector. Hash every clause-minus-one-literal; c(l,l') counts keys containing both. Accept when total literal count strictly drops, i.e. Λ+c>4, where Λ is the total length of the shared rests. Each step touches 2(Λ+c) ≤ 10·gain literals, so incrementally maintained tables cost Õ(L0·w·(w+n)) word operations over the whole run, with at most L0 steps and fresh variables (hand amortisation, unchecked). Run it once on the final target after BLQ/core, so exact-support blocks are undisturbed.

C. NEON58.
The quotient's negative blocks are the distributed CNF of OR_i(¬a_i ∧ ¬a_i'). Pairs (¬a_i,¬a_i') have c=8, then 4, then 2; the fourth has Λ+c=4 and is rejected. Six steps give 22 variables and 32 clauses: the fixture (pairs (1,2)…(15,16), fresh 17–22). Resolving out 17–22 returns the 48-clause pair-transversal formula.
Prediction for unchanged pinned v5 on the fixture:
- compression skipped (all_variables_in_odd_blocks); core UNKNOWN (no_clauses_removed);
- one root IALH call (my count: 172 windows, 3744 tuples, probably no rows);
- root DP eliminates 1..16, each replacing 5 clauses by 4, then 17, 20, 18, 21, 19 with subsumption (clause counts 16→12→9→6→4→empty clause);
- UNSAT, peak 0, about 21 accepted steps. If IALH refutes first, the peak is still 0.
Without RDP the root is STUCK: eliminating a_1 creates 32 resolvents for 12 clauses.

D. FRAGILITY FOUND.
RDP and size-nonincreasing DP are inverse at the margin. In the fixture all variables have occurrence product 4 and the index tie-break favours originals. For k=5 the gate accepts all five pairs per side (30 variables, 47 clauses). Originals then have product 5, fresh variables 2, and eliminating fresh variable 21 replaces 3 clauses by 2, which is allowed. Independent-test prediction: pinned elim's first accepted step eliminates 21, a second fresh variable per side is later undone (4 for 4), and root DP does not finish.
Repair proposal: an RDP variable becomes DP-eligible only after its definition clauses are consumed. With that gate I expect root DP to refute every k with poly(k) resolvents while the input has 2^(k+1) negative clauses. Conjecture, not proof.

E. STILL UNHANDLED.
- Products whose factors are sub-clauses (the positive cross block) need clause-set RDP. It is not needed here because DP absorbs it.
- Perturbed products: a neighbouring extra clause can create misaligned bicliques that greedy consumes first. Optimal factoring is a biclique-partition problem, believed NP-hard.
- Pigeonhole: the pair rule fires on at-most-one cliques for h≥4 (c=h−1) but only re-encodes them. The effect on IALH windows is unknown, possibly negative.
- Fixed points: on 3-uniform linear CNF (two clauses share at most one variable) BLQ sees only odd one-clause blocks, the core removes nothing, and no pair has a shared rest. Every certified reduction is the identity. Linear SAT is reported NP-complete (Porschen–Speckenmeyer–Zhao, from memory; verify). Any universal bound must therefore come from residual search alone, and nothing here supplies one.
missing_theorem:
M1 (restricted; plausibly provable; unproved here). Call B={t_1∨…∨t_k∨R0 : t_i∈T_i} ⊆ F a neighbour-free product block if the T_i are literal sets on pairwise disjoint variables and no clause of F outside B is obtained from a clause of B by replacing one factor literal with another literal. Claim: every maximal gain-positive pair-RDP run rewrites B, independently of all other clauses, to O(Σ|T_i|+|R0|) literals up to the Λ+c>4 margin, using Õ(L0·w·(w+n)) word operations in total. With the eligibility gate of D, root rewriting (RDP then DP) terminates with no RDP step undone.

M2 (needed for the k-pair family). With that gate, pinned min-product DP refutes the k-pair-transversal quotient at the root for all k with poly(k) resolvents. Hand-checked for k=4 only, where the gate is not even needed.

U (NOT claimed). A polynomial bound on Σ_layers|S| after BLQ/core/RDP closure for arbitrary CNF. On 3-uniform linear CNF the closure is the identity, so U restricted there is the original open problem. The exact remaining obstruction is a theorem bounding residual search on inputs with no translation kernel and no shared-rest pair; no component proposed so far addresses it.
self_attack:
1. The rule is known BVA. Only its placement, the undo analysis and the fixture are new.
2. The fixture is my hand-applied transformation of the quotient as described in the brief, not the output of any implementation. It tests the mechanism, not a detector. Its success depends on an index tie-break among variables of product 4.
3. My 21-step DP trace and the window count may contain slips. I did not compute the lattice hulls.
4. For k≥5 I predict pinned DP undoes RDP. The eligibility gate is untested; it restricts DP only on fresh variables but could still hurt.
5. RDP only unlocks DP. Where DP is stuck for other reasons it merely adds variables, enlarging IALH window sets and Lean obligations.
6. Greedy misalignment under neighbouring extras is real. M1 excludes it by hypothesis rather than solving it.
7. Nothing here touches linear or random 3-CNF, the old 88-clause case, or pigeonhole cost. U is as open as before.
8. The work bound in A3 treats sympy HNF as bounded by caps, which the rank-deficient branch does not guarantee.
mechanism_signature: Reverse-DP (bounded variable addition) on shared-rest literal pairs: replace a K(|L|,|Γ|) clause biclique by |L|+|Γ| clauses through one fresh variable; exact existential projection with a three-line proof; strict literal-count potential; then the deployed size-nonincreasing DP under a definition-consumed eligibility gate. Fixed points: linear CNF.
delta_from_prior: Round 88 proposed the prefix-trace number and a static order; round 87 folded product blocks into cube lines; round 86 proposed lookahead ordering and cache keys; Fable73 contracted link-twins by rewriting, which as summarised needs every clause to respect the twin. New here: (1) a purely syntactic rule that is the inverse of the deployed DP step, sound for arbitrary CNF with arbitrary extras, with no truth-table certificate or width cap; (2) a fixture that tests the mechanism on unchanged pinned v5 with no new code; (3) the predicted DP-undo failure at k=5 and a precise eligibility gate; (4) the linear-CNF fixed-point statement of what all certified reductions leave untouched; (5) audit items A3(ii)–(iv).
